Title: Azure Monitor for VMs is now available in East and South East Australia regions

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for VMs is now available in East Australia and South East Australia. Around the world, it's available in nine public regions.

Azure Monitor for VMs monitors your Azure virtual machines and virtual machine scale sets. The service analyzes the performance and health of your Windows and Linux VMs, monitoring their processes and their dependencies on other resources and external processes.

As a solution, Azure Monitor for VMs includes support for monitoring performance and application dependencies for VMs that are hosted on-premises or with another cloud provider.

For more information, see the Azure Monitor for VMs documentation.
